meta.name: frame-macos-notification
meta.description: 拟真 macOS 通知 banner + app icon + 标题正文, 适合 video overlay / 产品发布预告

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成拟真 macOS 通知横幅，用于视频叠加或产品预告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在视频或演示中模拟 macOS 系统通知效果
copy.tagline_en: Generate realistic macOS notification banners for video overlays or product teasers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to simulate macOS notification banners in videos or demos

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能将你的文字渲染成 macOS Big Sur 风格的通知横幅，包含应用图标、标题和正文，适合视频叠加或社交媒体图片。
howto.when: 当你要求生成一个 macOS 风格的通知横幅，或需要为视频、产品发布制作通知叠加层时触发。

say.text: 做一个暗色模式的 macOS 通知，应用名是“邮件”，显示“您有一封新邮件”。
say.note: Claude 会生成暗色磨砂玻璃效果的通知。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can render your text into a macOS Big Sur-style notification banner with app icon, title, and body, suitable for video overlays or social media images.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate a macOS-style notification banner, or need a notification overlay for video or product launch teasers.

say_en.text: Generate a macOS notification with title "New Version Released" and body "v2.0 is now available."
say_en.note: Claude will output a notification banner HTML.

say_en.text: Create a dark mode macOS notification with app name "Mail" showing "You have a new email."
say_en.note: Claude will generate a dark frosted glass notification.
